text: {"name": "bt_update_link_clock_offset", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Updates Bluetooth link timing/clock offset state by comparing received packet timing against the RF clock and adjusting the per-link offset when the mismatch exceeds defined thresholds.", "subsystem": "bt", "var_renames": {"v2": "conn_table", "v3": "conn_index", "v4": "conn", "v6": "ctx", "v8": "expected_time", "v9": "abs_time_diff", "v10": "list_node", "v11": "node_offset", "v12": "conn", "v13": "conn_flags"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 85, "meaning": "connection/link flags; bits 0x10 and 0x40 mark timing state"}, {"offset": 86, "meaning": "connection index or link identifier"}, {"offset": 87, "meaning": "selector passed to rf_read_state"}, {"offset": 88, "meaning": "adjusted clock/slot offset written for the link"}, {"offset": 92, "meaning": "expected packet or connection clock/timestamp"}, {"offset": 96, "meaning": "signed measured time/clock offset"}, {"offset": 107, "meaning": "group/piconet identifier used to match related link entries"}]}
